تستعروا (form VIII)
# تَسْتَعِرُوا (tastaʕirū) /tas.ta.ʕi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
# تُسْتَعَرُوا (tustaʕarū) /tus.ta.ʕa.ruː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِسْتَعَرَ (istaʕara)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
